sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-183724-914b, project ork, item S537:

run the new spec-open-key and decision-key checks on the slice's own spec and diff before the review, so a slice that adds such a check can see its own false positives
